Earth Signal

NASA Space Apps 2026 · Be an Earth System Trend Detective

See what is changing on Earth, and whether the change is real.

Earth Signal turns gridded NASA-style Earth observation data into answers. Choose a variable, a region and a confidence level, then explore interactive maps and charts that show where change is happening, how much per decade, and whether it is statistically significant. It also spots places where neighbouring regions move in opposite directions, writes a plain-English report and recommends your next steps.
